department: Faculty of Medicine, Munich Medical Research School (MMRS) and Dr. rer. nat. route

deadline.quote: The various core areas and associated programs set their own application deadlines and select their doctoral candidates for the Ph.D. independently

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: In many programs you must submit a project proposal developed with your future first TAC member at the time of application.
supervisor.quote: developed together with your future 1st TAC member at the time of application

entry_route.value: A master's or equivalent degree of at least 240 ECTS is required in medicine, a natural science, pharmacy, health sciences or a related subject.
entry_route.quote: A qualifying degree, i.e. a Master's degree or equivalent

english_waiver.value: English proof is required (EU B2, IELTS 5.0 to 6.5 or TOEFL 87 to 109) but may be submitted before the end of the second semester; native speakers and English-speaking university graduates are exempt.
english_waiver.quote: or who have a degree from an English-speaking university do not have to provide proof

also.quote: APS certificate (only required for degrees from China, India and Vietnam)

notes: Ph.D. Medical Research (MMRS core areas and associated programs) and the Dr. rer. nat. route under the Faculty of Medicine are covered together. The Dr. rer. nat. route applies to a natural-science master's supervised by an LMU Faculty of Medicine supervisor authorised to supervise.
